title: See Titan International at the 2026 Farm Progress Show in Boone, Iowa
body_markdown:
Come by and meet our longtime friends Cole the Cornstar, Welker Farms and NASCAR Driver Ross Chastain.


##


Aug 28, 2026


**Titan to Showcase Tire Savings, LSW® Payback Tools alongside Ag Personalities at the Farm Progress Show**


**


**QUINCY, IL <Aug. 27, 2026>** Farmers attending the 2026 Farm Progress Show September 1st – 3rd can save on their next qualifying tire purchase, **explore equipment fitted with Titan’s broad range of tires and tracks, and calculate the potential payback of Low Sidewall Technology® at Titan Booth #24S.** Visitors can also meet some of agriculture’s best-known personalities, enter a tire raffle benefiting Iowa FFA chapters and take part in the show’s Wednesday evening entertainment.


*Here's what visitors won't want to miss at the Titan booth:*


****


**Start with $200 in Tire Savings**


Farm Progress Show attendees can visit Titan Booth #24S to claim a certificate for **$200 off a qualifying tire purchase of $1,000 or more.** Titan representatives will be available to explain eligible brands, products, redemption details and provide a dealer quote to contact information.


****


**Bring your Equipment Questions and Calculate your Potential Return on Investment**


Farmers can work with Titan representatives to explore how Low Sidewall Technology® may fit their equipment and operation. Using Titan’s interactive LSW® Payback Calculator, visitors can evaluate potential return based on their own equipment and operation. In most scenarios, LSWs can pay for themselves in less than 18 months or sooner.


****


**Meet Ross Chastain, one of NASCAR’s most Popular Drivers**


NASCAR driver and **eighth-generation watermelon farmer, Ross Chastain,** will be at the Titan booth on Wednesday from 9 a.m. to 12 p.m. Visitors can meet Chastain, see his **Titan and Goodyear Farm Tires racecar** and learn more about his deep agricultural roots. Ross and his family run the Titan HK 458 and Goodyear Optitrac tires on their farm.


****


**Meet your Favorite Farm Influencers from Big Sky Montana and Iowa’s Fields of Dreams**


Throughout the show, attendees can meet some of agriculture's most recognizable social media personalities, see their equipment up close, and talk to them about their next projects.


- **The Welker Family of Welker Farms** will join the Titan team in the booth with their new restoration project, their John Deere 4520: Come meet them in the booth on Tuesday and Wednesday from 1-3 p.m. and on Thursday from 9-11 a.m. Farmers can talk to the Welkers about the **Titan Low Sidewall Technology products they have on their Big Bud 600/50, Beastbine Case 8230 combine, Clifford Case 8230 combine, Big Brute, their DEMCO Big Bud grain cart most and most recent restoration of the Big Bud KTTA 700.**


****


- **Cole the Cornstar (along with Cooper and Daddy Cornstar)** will be present in the booth on Tuesday and Wednesday from 10 a.m.-12 p.m. and on Thursday from 1 p.m.- 3 p.m. Titan will showcase Cooper's JCB 270T equipped with the new **Titan Rubber Tracks.** Cole and his family were also one of the first farms in the Midwest to test the **Goodyear R14T sprayer flotation tires** . Cole has even coined the phrase **“Hillside Stickability”** when it comes to the tires’ ability to climb the hillsides all while leaving behind a light footprint. Visitors can also talk to the Cornstar family about the Titan and Goodyear Farm Tires they have on their Case 340, Hagie Sprayer, John Deere 4840, and CAT Challenger MT 955C.


****


**Attend the First-Ever Farm Progress After Hours Drone Show on Wednesday**


The Farm Progress Show, in partnership with Van Wall Equipment, Titan and John Deere, will host an evening concert featuring Iowa **country artist Jason Brown and a pyrotechnic drone light show by Sky Elements** on September 2, 2026. The event is included with the Farm Progress Show admission. Food, fun and opening music will all get started right after booths close for the day. **The Country Sounds and Lights farmer appreciation event brought to the attendees by VanWall Equipment, Titan and John Deere will be hosted at the Titan/Van Wall booth 24S.**


****


**Win a Set of Four Tires while Supporting Iowa FFA**


Support the next generation of agricultural leaders through a special tire raffle benefiting Iowa FFA chapters. Visitors can purchase raffle tickets from FFA students at the Titan booth for a chance to win a set of four tires. **Winners may select tires from one of the following segments:**


- **Carlstar branded Lawn and Garden tires**
- **Titan branded High-speed Trailer tires**
- **ITP branded ATV and UTV tires**


Proceeds from the raffle will be distributed to participating Iowa FFA chapters, reinforcing Titan's commitment to strengthening rural communities and investing in the future of agriculture.


****


**Titan's Complete Off-Highway and High-Speed Trailer Portfolio**


As a one-stop shop for off-highway wheels and tires, Titan will showcase products from across its family of brands, including **Titan Wheels, Titan Farm Tires, Goodyear Farm Tires, A.C.E.S., Carlstar, Carlisle and ITP** . Visitors can explore solutions across multiple segments with more than 40 product lines and 100 tires on display.


**Plan Your Visit**


At Titan, farmers are at the center of everything we do. Whether you're looking to connect with industry experts, meet your favorite agricultural personalities, support local FFA chapters or learn about the latest tire and wheel innovations, Titan's booth offers something for everyone.


Make Booth #24S your first stop at the 2026 Farm Progress Show and see how Titan continues to support the people who keep agriculture moving forward.


# # # #


**About Titan International:**


Titan International, Inc. **** (NYSE: TWI), is a leading global manufacturer and supplier of wheels, tires, and undercarriage products for a wide variety of off-the-road equipment within the Agricultural, Earthmoving, Mining, Construction and Consumer sectors. Supporting a strong network of aftermarket dealers and blue-chip OEM customers all over the world, Titan is a company that end-users can count on for innovative and durable products and quality service.
